last_summary: Video 3 is the best-supported recipe for using two distinct creamy components in its dressing: fine observation shows a white creamy ingredient and a yellow creamy ingredient being added to the pasta bowl, and coarse observation shows the salad mixed and finished as a creamy pasta salad. Video 1 remains unresolved because mayonnaise and mustard are shown but a second creamy dressing component is not confirmed. Video 2 and Video 4 lack evidence of two distinct creamy dressing components.
